items.title: How SproutMe Cut Integration Test Time by 92.9% with DuckDB
items.summary: At [SproutMe](https://sproutme.ai/), a fast-moving, early-stage AI marketing startup, data engineer [Archit Dukhande](https://www.linkedin.com/in/archit-dukhande/) added DuckDB to their local development and CI workflow for a data-heavy AI product. Running the integration tests on DuckDB cut the step per merge by 92.9 percent, from 10.65 minutes to 0.76 minutes, so the team can ship several changes a day without putting users at risk.
